steps.comment: Mike's round 12 follow-up, 28 Oct: the Two Hundred's shadow over the Works floor until she flies, and the Middle Distance bench, now eleven squares south of the Barrow's.

steps.label: the shadow is on the floor, under everybody, and in nobody's way
standing on the floor's bottom row, in its middle column
and gone once the Two Hundred flies

steps.eval: window._said = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._said.push(t); add.call(this, t); }; $gameMap.event(23).start()

steps.check: [window._said.includes('It is very old. It has no plaque. Nobody'), window._said.some(t => /mound|north|south|east/.test(t))]
steps.label: before the Barrow's bench: old, and older than nothing in particular

steps.check: [window._said.includes('It is older than the one on the mound to the'), window._said.includes('north. It has no plaque. Nobody remembers who'), window._said.includes('north, facing the same water.')]
steps.label: after it: older than the one to the north, and sitting, the other one to the north
and nothing says east or south any more
